title: Compose tree completion functions using actual target column spans
statement: A subtree completion has f(P)=1[L subset image(P)] w(rank(P)), where L is the actual span of descendant target columns. Branching joins actual subspaces and multiplies weights; edge integration preserves this representation, visiting shared prefixes once. A leaf uses its affine lift count without an extra rank/image multiplicity.

requires: Supplied checked rooted tree and actual edge coordinates
provides: Compact exact tree populations and a source-reported positive joint sampler
assumptions: Target subspace orientation matters; rank alone is insufficient
All independent edge factors are sampled jointly
costs: O(n p) rank states/O(n p^2) scalar transitions plus paid matrix, integer and complete-output work
contract.units: Exact finite-field dimensions, integer populations and rational probabilities; wall-clock observations in seconds.
contract.obstruction: Do not treat a shared prefix as separate independent paths or multiply leaf rank multiplicities.

evidence.quote: **I completed a broader raw-input chain-module construction and a separate construction for branching matrix-product trees.** Both now have governing proofs, executable implementations and completed version-bound internal reviews.
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Literal tree/field/edge-variable interpretation is supplied and checked; hidden arbitrary-depth acquisition from ordinary Boolean circuits is not established. Leaves require exact target matrices, not just ranks. This is separate from the acquired mixed-Hom raw pipeline and does not establish unrestricted affine conditioning or arbitrary-circuit counting. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Producer reports governing proofs, implementations and completed version-bound internal reviews. Their original bytes were not acquired in this return; preserve this availability gap without relabelling the reported completed science as unaudited. No new export or retry is required.
